edit_decision.purpose: Exclude source cues 5-7 containing unsupported food-safety generalizations; preserve original English audio, no TTS.
edit_decision.required_renderer_change: Current PR #269 renderer accepts a single contiguous cut; two-segment concatenation needs separately tested branch-only implementation, not pretend main supports it.
edit_decision.caption_quality: Original cue 3/4 mobile readability and spoken sync require real audio-aligned splitting. No fabricated timings or approved SRT.
edit_decision.seam_risk: 28s cut to source 65s: verify no clipped words, music discontinuity, abrupt visual jump, lip sync, and audio levels; 34-35s trailing section may lack subtitle, do not fill with invented words.
edit_decision.framing: 9:16 center crop of 1920x1080 source may remove hands, text and brand; full-duration independent QC needed.
